definition: This dimension controls how containers can be used to hold other containers, varying from simple item slots to complex nested inventories. Games may implement different rules for how items are stored, retrieved, and managed within these nested structures.
exclusion_criteria: Flat inventory systems without any container mechanics
Inventory systems where all items are stored directly in the main inventory without hierarchy
inclusion_criteria: Allows containers to hold other containers
Supports varying limits on nesting depth
title: Container Nesting Mechanics
